title: docs(skills): teach the approvals inbox nav entry gated on the approvals service, not requiresObject

_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XUx5cLjpSpHyiVnPbcfsvhK)_

domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kCq2ZxdEfiiXADAhS

Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ui` 技能的导航规则示例里,审批入口从「`type: 'object'` 指向 `sys_approval_request` + `requiresObject` 门」改为平台 Account 应用同款写法:`type: 'component'`、`componentRef: 'approvals:inbox'`、`requiresService: 'approvals'`,并用一句注释说明为何不能用 `requiresObject`;对应 eval 的期望输出与断言同步改。
- 为什么改:照抄旧示例的应用里,非管理员审批人(销售经理、主管等)在没有任何审批单涉及他们之前,读 `sys_approval_request` 的对象元数据得 404,控制台据此把入口裁掉,于是新环境里没有一个审批人看得见审批收件箱。
- 风险与回滚:纯技能文字,`skills/**` 两个文件各改 3 行、净增 0 行;不动 schema、不动运行时;回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` 第 37–39 行,再看 eval 第 17、20–21 行。
- 两分钟验证:`git diff origin/main -- skills/`,预期只见审批那一项换成 component + `requiresService: 'approvals'`,eval 断言改为要求 `approvals:inbox`、`requiresService`,并禁止 `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`。
- 需要你做的:受管面 Tier H(`skills/**`):请批准或合并。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` lines 37–39**, inside the `os:check` app example. The approvals item

  `{ id: 'nav_approval_requests', type: 'object', objectName: 'sys_approval_request', label: 'Approval Requests', icon: 'inbox', requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request' }`

  becomes

  `{ id: 'nav_approvals', type: 'component', componentRef: 'approvals:inbox', label: 'Approvals', icon: 'inbox', requiresService: 'approvals' }`

  and the comment that taught "Reference system objects via `requiresObject` so the menu auto-hides" now reads "The inbox component, gated on the approvals service. Not `requiresObject`: the object read answers 404 to approvers until a request involves them."
- **`skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` eval 2.** `expected_output` describes the approvals inbox as `type: 'component', componentRef: 'approvals:inbox'` gated by `requiresService: 'approvals'`, never `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`. `must_contain` swaps `requiresObject` for `approvals:inbox` and `requiresService`; `must_not_contain` adds `requiresObject: 'sys_approval_request'`.
- **`.changeset/33235-skills-approvals-inbox-nav-gate.md`**: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, carrying both declaration lines.

## Why

The shape taught is the platform's own, quoted from `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/account.app.ts` lines 114–128 on `origin/main` d4fbb4db (comment lines trimmed):

```ts
id: 'nav_account_approvals',
type: 'component',
label: 'Approvals',
componentRef: 'approvals:inbox',
icon: 'check-circle',
// `requiresObject` cannot gate a component item — it names the
// object the entry ROUTES to, and this one routes to a component.
// The capability that must be present is the approvals SERVICE
// (`ctx.registerService('approvals', …)` in plugin-approvals), ...
requiresService: 'approvals',
```

The same file (lines 100–109) also explains why the destination is the component and not the `sys_approval_request` grid: the decision actions need the `viewer` block that only the approvals REST path attaches, so the object route renders rows an approver cannot act on. The new example teaches both halves.

How each gate is applied, read on `origin/main` d4fbb4db:

- **`requiresService` is enforced server-side.** `packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts:1098` (the app) and `:1110` (each navigation entry, inside `filterNav`) drop an entry whose service the kernel does not hold; `resolveRegisteredServices` (`:1304`) probes every `requiresService` named under `navigation`, `areas`, `children` and `widgets`, and fails open when the kernel cannot be probed. plugin-approvals registers the service at `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approvals-plugin.ts:414` (`ctx.registerService('approvals', this.service)`).
- **The console passes `requiresService` through and prunes `requiresObject`.** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx:336-337` asks `checkCap('object', …)` and `checkCap('service', …)`; `checkCap` (`:251-264`) judges objects against the served object scope and returns `true` for every service, so the console relies on the server having already stripped an unavailable one. This refines the order's mechanism assumption ("the console really prunes `requiresService` items"): the server prunes, the console does not re-check. It agrees with the card, which says only that the console prunes against the served objects, and with the Account app's own comment.
- **`componentRef: 'approvals:inbox'`** resolves through the console's component registry: `ui/apps/console/src/registerApprovalsComponents.tsx:59` registers `ref: 'approvals:inbox'` to the Approvals Inbox page, mounted at `/apps/{app}/component/approvals/inbox`.
- **The schema accepts the shape.** `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts:451` declares `requiresService` on every navigation item and `:741` declares `componentRef` on the component item. The example sits in an `os:check` block and type-checks (Verification below).

The card's measurement on 18.4.0 (a non-administrator approver reads `GET /api/v1/meta/object/sys_approval_request` as 404 until a request involves them) was not re-measured here; the fix does not depend on it, because the taught item no longer names the object at all.

## Acceptance notes

- Other copies swept with `git grep` on `origin/main` d4fbb4db over `skills/` for `requiresObject`, `requiresService`, `sys_approval_request` and `approvals:inbox`: the navigation rule and its eval are the only places that teach the approvals nav entry. `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md:166-168` states the general rule (use `requiresObject` / `requiresService` on an item that depends on an optional object or service) and stays correct; `SKILL.md:192`'s blueprint row lists `requiresObject` as a navigation pattern and names no approvals entry, so it is untouched. The `sys_approval_request` mentions under `skills/objectstack-automation/` describe the approval state table, not navigation.
- HotCRM-derived apps that copied the old shape (the card cites a downstream app) are not touched here; the skill text is the whole scope of this card.

## Verification

Head `77236122`, base `origin/main` d4fbb4db.
